headline: GOLDEN GATE ZONE SURGES 320m NORTHEAST: Goliath GOT Drills 10.32 g/t Au Over 6.00m in New Expansion Area at Surebet Discovery, Golden Triangle B.C.
snippet: Goliath Resources Ltd. (TSX-V: GOT) released August 11, 2026 assay results from hole GD-26-424 intersecting 10.32 g/t Au over 6.00 metres, including 33.80 g/t Au over 1.82 metres, within the newly confirmed 320-metre northeast extension of the Golden Gate Zone at its 100%-owned Surebet Discovery on the Golddigger Property, Golden Triangle, British Columbia. Visible gold has been identified in 20 of 35 drill holes completed in the 2026 season — an unusually high visibility rate correlating with coarse, free-milling gold amenable to conventional CIL processing. The confirmed aggregate expansion of the Golden Gate Zone to the northeast now totals 860 metres. Goliath is running one of the most heavily funded junior gold exploration programs in BC this season: seven diamond drill rigs, approximately 50,000 metres planned, 25,651 metres in 45 completed holes against 98 planned with the zone remaining open laterally and at depth. The Surebet Discovery sits in the same Golden Triangle district that hosts Seabridge Gold's KSM (38 Moz Au) and the operating Brucejack gold mine; sustained 10+ g/t intercepts across a growing zone with a fully funded multi-rig program at gold above $4,400 places this discovery squarely in the target window for major-company acquisition interest.

headline: ROSE WEST EXPANDS 300x300m: Critical Elements CRE Hits 1.89% Li2O Over 27.35m in Phase 2 Quebec Lithium Program — Footprint Targeting 1,250x2,000m
source_name: Yahoo Finance / Critical Elements Lithium Corp. (TSX-V: CRE)
snippet: Critical Elements Lithium Corp. (TSX-V: CRE) released August 12, 2026 assay results from Phase 2 of its 10,000-metre Summer 2026 exploration program at the 100%-owned Rose West Discovery in Eeyou Istchee, Québec. Drill holes RW-26-35A, RW-26-51, RW-26-52, and RW-26-58 returned composite assays including 1.89% Li2O and 161 ppm Ta2O5 over 27.35 metres, confirming an additional 300x300-metre block expanding the lateral footprint of Pegmatites 5, 3, and 2, with thicknesses ranging from 10 to 30 metres. The program targets an ultimate mineralized footprint of approximately 1,250x2,000 metres across a multi-pegmatite LCT system. At 1.89% Li2O, this result exceeds the typical 1.0–1.2% economic threshold for hard-rock lithium production and places Rose West in the top quartile of active Canadian LCT pegmatite programs by grade. Quebec's combination of low-cost hydroelectric power, established mining infrastructure corridor, and the James Bay and Northern Quebec Agreement framework makes it the preferred jurisdiction for hard-rock lithium processing in North America. For investors tracking the lithium cycle, quality Canadian lithium pegmatite programs at grades above 1.5% Li2O with multi-pegmatite system scale represent the exploration tier most likely to attract major-company acquisition interest as demand recovers toward 2027–2028.

headline: KALAHARI COPPER BELT TARGET CONFIRMED: Leviathan LVX 14 Holes Validate DKF-NPF Contact and Domal Structure at Botswana Central Project — Targeting Khoemacau-Style Deposits
snippet: Leviathan Metals Corp. (TSX-V: LVX) released an August 12, 2026 update from its 100%-owned Central Project in the Kalahari Copper Belt, Botswana, confirming that 14 widely-spaced diamond drill holes totalling approximately 3,600 metres have intercepted the D'Kar-Ngwako Pan Formation (DKF-NPF) contact — the specific sedimentary horizon hosting copper-silver mineralisation at MMG Limited's adjacent Khoemacau Mine — in 12 of 14 holes. Drilling also confirmed the presence of a domal structure at Central previously predicted from ground magnetic and helicopter-borne AEM survey data, meaning the primary geological control on Khoemacau-style mineralisation is now validated by subsurface drilling. Step-out drilling targeting the nose and both limbs of the domal structure is planned and in progress pending assay receipt. Khoemacau is one of the world's highest-grade copper-silver mines in production; confirming the same DKF-NPF horizon and structural setting in an adjacent property represents one of the most de-risked discovery frameworks available in the junior copper exploration sector. At copper above US$6.60/lb, finding a Khoemacau-comparable geological setting within the same belt and immediately adjacent to the operating mine is a material exploration milestone that warrants close attention ahead of assay results.

headline: FIRST FULL DRILL TEST: Relevant Gold RGC Launches 5,000m at Burr Shear Zone, Lewiston Wyoming — 3D Geological Model Points to Larger Gold System
source_name: Toronto Telegraph / Relevant Gold Corp. (TSX-V: RGC)
snippet: Relevant Gold Corp. (TSX-V: RGC) announced August 12, 2026 the commencement of a fully funded and permitted 5,000-metre oriented diamond drill program at the Burr target zone within its 100%-owned Lewiston Project in west-central Wyoming, USA — the first comprehensive drill test of an integrated geological model developed across two years of drilling, structural mapping, geochemistry, and VTEM geophysics. The program is designed to follow the gold-bearing shear zone identified at Burr beyond the 300-metre section tested in 2024 and target newly defined parallel structures. An expanded drill permit has been submitted that, if approved, would extend access to 2.5 additional kilometres of the Burr trend and the parallel Sweetwater trend. Wyoming represents an increasingly attractive gold exploration jurisdiction: established federal permitting processes, low-cost logistics, no constitutional barriers to open-pit heap leach extraction, and a mining law framework that facilitated recent Barrick and Nevada Gold Mines expansions in adjacent Nevada. At gold above $4,400/oz, bulk-tonnage shear-zone-hosted gold systems in stable US jurisdictions with established road infrastructure generate project economics that were marginal at $2,000 gold and are now compelling across a wide range of deposit scales.

headline: COCHILCO LIFTS 2026 COPPER FORECAST TO $5.95/LB — AND CUTS CHILE OUTPUT 2.6% TO 5.27M TONNES: Official Regulator Confirms Structural Supply Squeeze
snippet: Cochilco — Chile's official copper market regulator and the world's most authoritative copper supply analyst — published its August 2026 quarterly report upgrading its 2026 average copper price forecast to US$5.95 per pound while simultaneously cutting its 2026 Chilean copper output forecast to 5.27 million tonnes (down 2.6%). The output reduction reflects lower-than-expected production from Codelco's El Teniente mine (now under a two-year partial suspension), reduced throughput at BHP's Escondida and Spence, and ongoing grade declines at mature Chilean open-pit operations. The price upgrade itself lags the current COMEX spot price of approximately US$6.66/lb, meaning the actual market is already running well above even Cochilco's revised central case. For junior copper investors, the structural implication is unambiguous: the world's largest copper-producing nation is simultaneously producing less copper AND forecasting higher prices, confirming that the supply-demand tightness is structural supply attrition rather than cyclical demand froth. At copper above US$6.00/lb sustained for a quarter, the entire BC, Nevada, and Latin American porphyry copper development pipeline that was predicated on $4.00–$4.50/lb economics is economically transformed — drill results and resource estimates at projects across the sector need to be re-underwritten on current price decks.

headline: CHILE AUTHORIZES CODELCO TO KEEP 100% OF 2025 PROFITS — Extraordinary Reinvestment Move Sparks Political Dispute as El Teniente Capital Crisis Deepens
snippet: The Chilean government authorized state copper mining company Codelco to retain and reinvest 100% of its 2025 profits on August 10, 2026 — an extraordinary departure from the standard arrangement that directs a substantial share of Codelco profits to Chile's national treasury and triggered an immediate opposition political dispute. The decision reveals the scale of Codelco's capital crisis: the El Teniente mine's Andes Norte partial suspension (up to two years after June seismic events), combined with the Rajo Inca open-pit expansion at El Salvador and Chuquicamata underground conversion, creates simultaneous capital demands across Codelco's three largest assets. Codelco cannot fund these simultaneously at its existing debt levels without retaining all operating cash flow. For global copper market investors, this is a critical macro signal: Chile's government itself is now formally acknowledging that Codelco's capital requirements exceed normal profit distribution norms — an admission that Chile, which produces approximately 25% of the world's copper, cannot be expected to deliver production growth over the next 24–36 months. The political dispute adds a secondary risk: if opposition challenges succeed, the reinvestment authorization could be reversed, forcing Codelco to distribute capital it needs for capital expenditure.

headline: TECK AND CENTERRA BOTH DOUBLE DOWN: Metal Energy MERG Gets Strategic Top-Up From Two Majors to Maintain 9.9% Stakes at Highland Valley-Adjacent Copper Project
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Metal Energy Corp. (TSX-V: MERG)
snippet: Metal Energy Corp. (TSX-V: MERG) announced August 11, 2026 that both Centerra Gold Inc. and Teck Resources Limited exercised top-up rights to maintain their respective 9.9% equity interests in the company — a mechanism requiring both strategic investors to pay cash into the company to prevent dilution. Teck Resources operates the Highland Valley Copper (HVC) mine in British Columbia, Canada's largest copper mine, which shares the same geological setting and district trend as Metal Energy's 100%-owned Highland Valley Project. When the operator of an adjacent world-class copper mine voluntarily pays anti-dilution cash to maintain a near-10% equity stake in a junior explorer on the same trend — and when a second major company (Centerra Gold) simultaneously makes the same commitment — it constitutes one of the strongest possible validations of early-stage project potential. At copper above US$6.60/lb, HVC's neighbour status to Metal Energy's project is highly material: Teck has decades of geological understanding of the Highland Valley porphyry system's footprint and would not maintain a near-10% equity position without a thesis on where the next porphyry copper discovery along that trend might be. Metal Energy also holds the NIV Cu-Au-Mo project in BC's Toodoggone District and the Manibridge Ni-Cu-Co-PGE project in Manitoba.

headline: LI-FT POWER CLOSES C$23M BOUGHT DEAL AT C$2.90 — Hard-Rock Lithium Explorer Funded as Institutional Demand Signals Battery Metals Capital Cycle Turning
source_name: Junior Mining Network / Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSX-V: LIFT / ASX: LFT)
snippet: Li-FT Power Ltd. (TSX-V: LIFT / ASX: LFT) completed August 12, 2026 a brokered bought deal public offering of 7,935,000 common shares at C$2.90 per share for gross proceeds of C$23,011,500, including full exercise of the over-allotment option. Li-FT Power is focused on LCT (lithium-cesium-tantalum) pegmatite exploration in Canada's Northwest Territories, where geologically significant spodumene pegmatites have been identified in recent years. The bought deal structure — in which broker-dealers commit firm capital rather than offering on a best-efforts basis — signals that institutional demand was sufficient for underwriters to take balance-sheet risk on the transaction, a materially higher threshold than a marketed offering. The simultaneous closing of Li-FT's C$23M bought deal and the release of positive Phase 2 drill results from Critical Elements (TSX-V: CRE) at Rose West on the same date (August 12) suggests that institutional appetite for quality Canadian hard-rock lithium exploration is returning after a prolonged 2024–2025 trough. For junior mining investors tracking battery metal cycles, simultaneous institutional-grade capital raises across multiple quality lithium explorers on the same day is one of the early leading indicators of capital cycle turning points — which historically precede the commodity price recovery by 12–18 months.

headline: GUYANA URANIUM FUNDED: U92 Energy UTWO Closes $8.05M With Haywood and Jett Capital — Kurupung Project in Under-Explored South American Uranium Belt
source_name: Investing News Network / U92 Energy Corp. (TSX-V: UTWO)
snippet: U92 Energy Corp. (TSX-V: UTWO) completed August 12, 2026 a brokered public offering of 20,125,000 units at $0.40 per unit — including full over-allotment exercise — for aggregate gross proceeds of $8,050,000, with co-lead agents Haywood Securities Inc. and Jett Capital Advisors LLC receiving a 5.3% cash commission. Proceeds are earmarked to advance U92's Kurupung uranium project in Guyana and satisfy deferred acquisition cash consideration on the Guyana project portfolio. The Guyana uranium belt — covering the Roraima Basin and adjacent crystalline basement — is a prospective but systematically underexplored sandstone-hosted and basement-hosted uranium district in South America. At uranium spot prices around US$86/lb — supported by accelerating US utility contracting timelines, the effective 2028 deadline on Russian uranium import bans, and a global construction pipeline of 70+ reactors — funding a new uranium exploration program in a less-explored district represents the speculative tier of the uranium equities spectrum. The Haywood Securities involvement is notable: Haywood has a strong uranium and critical metals franchise and has historically participated in high-quality uranium equity financings; their co-lead role signals this is not a promotional financing but a quality-brokered transaction. For retail investors following the uranium theme, Guyana adds South American district diversification to a uranium equity portfolio that is otherwise heavily concentrated in the Athabasca Basin, Namibia, Kazakhstan, and Australia.

headline: CAN CPI REVIVE GOLD AFTER $4,430 REJECTION? FXEmpire: Tame Inflation Creates Asymmetric Setup — $4,500 in Sight if Dollar Squeeze Doesn't Cap the Move
snippet: FXEmpire's August 12, 2026 gold and silver technical and fundamental forecast examines whether today's tame July CPI reading sustains gold above the $4,430 resistance level that rejected two earlier attempts in early August, or whether a mid-session dollar-driven pullback toward the $4,370–$4,400 range represents profit-taking ahead of the next leg. The key analytical tension: gold entered the CPI print already technically extended after eight consecutive sessions of gains, creating a buy-the-rumour, sell-the-news risk that partially materialized in Wednesday afternoon trading — but the structural tailwinds (central bank accumulation running at 21-month records, PBoC at 2,366 tonnes, negative real rates, BRICS reserve diversification, and July's negative payroll print that already removed September from the Fed hike calendar) remain fully intact regardless of today's intraday action. Silver is assessed as the higher-conviction long position in this environment for the first time in the 2026 cycle: the gold-silver ratio has compressed from 72x to 66x over 30 days, and solar-industrial demand continues compounding onto a six-consecutive-year structural supply deficit. For retail investors watching whether the CPI-driven gold move is durable: $4,430 is not a ceiling that must be cleared on the first attempt — it is a consolidation zone that, once volume builds above it, becomes the base for a technically confirmed move toward $4,500 and then $4,600 before year-end 2026.
